text: A border collie named Bracken won best in show at the Eddlestone dog trials on Saturday, edging out 42 other entrants at the Kirkway Fields grounds. Judges praised the seven-year-old dog’s speed, control and calm handling through the final agility and obedience rounds. Owner and trainer Mera Long of Fenwick said Bracken had trained for the event since early spring. The annual trials drew about 300 spectators despite steady drizzle, with competitors from five nearby parishes. Eddlestone Agricultural Society chair Robin Vale said, “Bracken was the clear standout today, and the crowd could see it from the first run.” Organisers said the event raised £1,180 for the parish hall repair fund.
